# Featured Papers

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
#### [Actin and myosin dynamics during epithelial remodeling in avian gastrulation](<https://doi.org/10.1242/dev.205461>)
*Yu Ieda, Carole Phan, Olinda Alegria-Prévot, Aurélien Villedieu, Jérôme Gros* <br>
Epithelial remodeling in gastrulating quail embryos relies primarily on junctional myosin contraction rather than medio-apical flows, providing key mechanical insights into cell extrusion and primitive streak formation.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
#### [Algebraic Representation of Mitochondrial Dynamics](<https://doi.org/10.1007/s11538-026-01738-9>)
*Raphael Mostov, Greyson Lewis, Gabriel Sturm, Wallace F. Marshall* <br>
Framing cellular morphological operations as category-theoretic morphisms establishes an edit-distance metric for structural similarity, enabling the visualization of biological data and providing a framework to define cell state-spaces based on dynamic processes rather than static shapes.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
#### [Optimal Control of Periodic Nonequilibrium Mechanochemical Systems via Automatic Differentiation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03217v1>)
*W. Callum Wareham, David A. Sivak* <br>
Minimizing energy dissipation in periodic molecular machines requires rotating their probability distributions at a constant speed without altering their shape to reduce mechanical heat, alongside suppressing chemical transitions that generate high heat.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
#### [Optimizing diffusion-limited transport, with applications to electrochemical systems](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00849v1>)
*Manu Mannattil, L. Mahadevan* <br>
A "bang-ride" current protocol, which applies maximum current until reaching a boundary's critical concentration limit and then progressively tapers it, maximizes charge transfer in diffusion-limited systems across both charging and discharging regimes.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
#### [Membrane lipid metabolism as a regulatory frontier in neural crest biology: Roles for sphingolipids, cholesterol, and lipid rafts](<https://doi.org/10.1002/dvdy.70182>)
*Allison E. Mancini, Mallorie P. Jenne, Michael L. Piacentino* <br>
Plasma membrane lipid dynamics regulate neural crest cell transitions by organizing morphogen signaling and altering membrane biophysics, illuminating how dysregulated lipid metabolism causes congenital neurocristopathies.
:::
